description: Inspect raw/canonical XRPL ledger objects associated with an account. Use this low-level view for ledger object types that do not have a dedicated N9T2 lister, or when canonical ledger-entry fields are required. For account-level NFT offers, set object_type to nft_offer to filter NFTokenOffer ledger entries. Use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_offers for classic DEX offers and n9t2_xrpl_list_account_channels for payment channels.

object_type.description: Optional XRPL ledger-entry type filter. Use 'nft_offer' for account-level NFTokenOffer ledger entries.
object_type.title: Object Type

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects
